what: A resumed receipt in 'finalizing' is still followed by status only. Studio cannot tell from the status when a finish is no longer held, so it was not changed (lead decision D3). Server and contract unchanged.

statusFieldsRead.expiresAt: present, but it is the receipt lifetime (24 hours for v1, 7 days for v2), not the finalization lease
statusFieldsRead.parts[].leaseExpiresAt: present, but it is each part's writing lease; the finalize lease is on the receipt row
statusFieldsRead.lastError: present; a v1 crash during finalize leaves it unchanged, because failure() never runs
statusFieldsRead.finalization: v2 only: jobId, phase (queued|assembling|verifying|cleaning|complete), completedParts; no job status, job error or lease

checks.studio:typecheck: not run: no Studio file changed
checks.studio:test: not run: no Studio file changed

gaps.what: v1: the receipt status has no finalization lease expiry. finalize sets usp_source_uploads.lease_expires_at (lease(), 180 seconds) and re-finalizes only after it passes, but status() never publishes that column, so Studio cannot see when a 'finalizing' v1 receipt is no longer held.
gaps.missingField: LargeUploadStatusSchema: a top-level leaseExpiresAt (ISO datetime, nullable) read from usp_source_uploads.lease_expires_at

gaps.what: v2: the status never says, while state is 'finalizing', that the storage job ended without a result. A terminal job failure (failV2Job, FINALIZATION_ATTEMPTS, SOURCE_CONTEXT_CHANGED) moves the receipt back to 'receiving' with lastError, which the existing follow already ends on and shows in the server's words. A crash leaves 'finalizing' with the job 'running' or 'queued'; finalization carries only jobId, phase and completedParts, so the job's own status and error and the receipt lease are not visible.
gaps.missingField: LargeUploadStatusSchema.finalization: the job status (queued|running|failed|succeeded) and its error from jobs where id = body.storageJobId, or the same top-level leaseExpiresAt as v1

next: Once the status carries leaseExpiresAt (v1) and the job status (v2), the Studio change is small: in runUpload's status follow, when a resumed 'finalizing' receipt shows an expired lease or a failed job, send finalize once with uploadGuard(receipt, key()) and the same sha256, show 'The last finish was interrupted; finishing the upload again.', and keep following; a refusal shows the server's words and the existing Cancel upload.
